papers.title_en: P-BFM: Perceptive Behavioral Foundation Models for Humanoid Control via Unsupervised Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Xue Wang, Yitang Li, Yiming Zhang, Siqin Wang, Junhan Sun, Zhihao Liu, Yaojie Shen, Jingbo Yuan, Hao Zhao, Qingdu Li
papers.evidence: 基于无监督强化学习的感知行为基础模型用于地形条件人形全身控制
papers.tldr: 人形行为基础模型需用可复用全身行为覆盖不同地形下的同一意图，但地形匹配演示需枚举行为与地形组合，成本高昂。P-BFM将控制分解为地形无关的行为意图与地形条件化实现，用前向-后向表示构建共享意图空间，并以显式根指令分离全局运输和局部全身适应。在挑战地形上，它无需地形特定演示即可让固定意图产生步高、步幅、姿态与落脚点变化，提升运动保真、根控制精度和扰动恢复。单一冻结策略还支持多任务并零样本迁移至Unitree G1。
papers.abstract_en: Behavioral foundation models (BFMs) provide humanoids with reusable repertoires of whole-body behaviors; in real-world humanoid control, the same behavioral intent may require fundamentally different motions under different terrain constraints. Covering such variation with terrain-matched demonstrations requires enumerating a combinatorial space of behaviors and terrain geometries. We introduce P-BFM, a perceptive behavioral foundation model that factorizes humanoid control into terrain-invariant intent and terrain-conditioned realization. A forward-backward representation maps motion references, target states, and reward functions into a shared intent space without terrain information, while a perceptive policy learns how to realize each intent under the surrounding terrain geometry. We further identify a complementary limitation of purely latent control: behavioral latents can preserve local motion patterns while losing precise global progress. We therefore introduce Explicit Root Instructions (ERI), which separates global transport (e.g., heading and planar velocity) from behavioral intent, while leaving local whole-body adaptation to the perceptive policy. This decomposition leads to a characteristic capability absent from conventional BFMs: one fixed intent induces different, terrain-appropriate behaviors, including changes in step height, stride, posture, foothold placement, and contacts, without terrain-specific demonstrations. Across challenging terrains, P-BFM improves motion fidelity, root-control precision, and perturbation recovery over strong baselines. A single frozen policy further supports motion tracking, goal reaching, reward inference, teleoperation, and terrain-aware recovery, and transfers zero-shot to a Unitree G1 using onboard depth sensing.

papers.title_en: Tread: A Visuo-Inertial Framework for Terrain and Locomotion Context-Aware Gait-Phase and Speed Estimation in Wearable Robotics
papers.authors: Debadrata Sarkar, Akash Bachhar, Aman Arora
papers.evidence: 面向可穿戴辅助机器人的视惯地形感知与步态相位速度估计
papers.tldr: 可穿戴助行机器人需连续估计地形、运动模式、步态相位与速度，但现有方法多分离建模且数据协议不一。本文提出胸挂相机与四下肢IMU的视觉-惯性因果流水线：ATP预判地形，TALMI识别模式并生成PLC向量，共享GKE估计步态相位和速度。ATP准确率96.3%、提前1.46 s；TALMI平地/楼梯准确率93.7%/98.8%，切换延迟低于200 ms；LOSO步态相位RMSE为1.75%/2.97%/4.55%，速度RMSE 0.218 km/h。该框架统一多任务估计，并以融合欧拉角降低安装变化依赖。
papers.abstract_en: A wearable assistive robot must continuously estimate terrain, locomotion mode, gait phase, and walking speed. These quantities are commonly addressed by separate, terrain-specific models, with datasets rarely collected under a common protocol. This paper presents a visuo-inertial framework that connects these estimates through a causal pipeline using a chest-mounted camera and four lower-limb inertial measurement units (IMUs). Anticipatory Terrain Perception (ATP) classifies incoming terrain with 96.3% accuracy and anticipates terrain transitions by 1.46 s on average. Terrain-Aware Locomotion Mode Identification (TALMI) achieves 93.7% and 98.8% accuracy for its level-ground and stairs experts respectively, with mean transition latencies being below 200 ms. The relevant TALMI posterior is retained as a Probabilistic Locomotion Context (PLC) vector and provided to a shared Gait Kinematic Encoder (GKE), which supports 50-Hz bilateral gait-phase estimation and 2-Hz walking-speed estimation. Leave-one-subject-out evaluation yields gait-phase RMSEs of 1.75%, 2.97%, and 4.55% for level walking, stair ascent, and stair descent respectively while estimating speed over 3.5-5.5 km/h with a RMSE of 0.218 km/h. All inertial sensing based models use sensor-fused Euler angles as input rather than raw accelerometer and gyroscope signals, reducing dependence on sensor mounting variation.

papers.title_en: Beyond Kinematic Tracking: Preserving Expressive Characteristics in Humanoid Whole-Body Control
papers.authors: Lingfan Bao, Hanshang Zhu, Yan Pan, Jincheng Wang, Jingyang Yu, Tianhu Peng, Yiyang Jia, Dimitrios Kanoulas, Chengxu Zhou
papers.evidence: 通过残差学习实现保留表现性动作特征的人形全身控制
papers.tldr: 人形机器人全身控制需忠实复现动作及其表现力，但现有跟踪器多优化关节/关键点误差与稳定性，平均位置误差低未必能保留动态与姿态特征。为此，作者在冻结跟踪器上引入残差学习，以幅度、能量、身体扩张、身体倾斜和骨盆高度为补偿目标，并用运动感知门控按身体部位活跃度分配修正能力。随后将各动作类别的残差策略蒸馏为统一策略。Unitree G1 仿真与实物八类动作实验表明，该方法比基线更好地保留动态和姿态表现力。
papers.abstract_en: Whole-body control plays a crucial role in enabling humanoid robots to execute expressive motions. Faithful execution requires preserving both the intended action and its expressive characteristics. Existing whole-body trackers typically balance joint and keypoint tracking with physical stability across diverse motions, but these objectives do not necessarily prioritize the expressive characteristics of each action. Our analysis shows that lower average positional tracking error does not guarantee better preservation of dynamic and postural motion characteristics. To address this gap, we propose a residual learning framework with compensation objectives targeting amplitude, energy, body expansion, body lean, and pelvis height. To concentrate compensation while limiting interference with the underlying tracking behavior, motion-aware gating allocates correction capacity according to body-part activity, preserving larger correction ranges in more active parts and restricting them elsewhere. For each frozen tracker, we train motion-specific residual policies and distill them into a unified policy shared across motion categories. Simulation and physical experiments on the Unitree G1 across eight motion categories demonstrate superior preservation of dynamic and postural motion characteristics compared with the corresponding baselines.

papers.title_en: KODA: Kinematics--Observation Data Alignment for Humanoid Learning from Human Egocentric Demonstration
papers.authors: Zibo Zhou, Yueru Chen, Junsong Wu, Weiji Xie, Qingyao Xu, Sheng Yin, Shiqing Wang, Jiyuan Shi, Siheng Chen, Chenjia Bai, Xuelong Li
papers.evidence: 对齐人类自我中心演示以训练人形机器人全身视觉-语言-动作策略
papers.tldr: 人形全身VLA训练依赖昂贵的机器人示范，且示范需对齐机器人视角与控制器兼容标签；人类自我中心视频虽可扩展，却有视角错位和动作稀疏问题。KODA用可复用的规范轨迹对齐运动学与观测：先以稀疏跟踪和采样命令优化生成仿真校验的全身轨迹，据此合成机器人视角观测，再为不同控制器重生成状态动作监督。在Unitree G1四项移动操作任务及SONIC与HEFT控制器上，固定机器人数据时，人类示范覆盖但机器人数据缺失条件的成功率分别提升45.0和46.25个百分点。该方法提升了人类示范数据的跨控制器复用性与扩展潜力。
papers.abstract_en: Training humanoid whole-body vision-language-action (VLA) policies requires costly robot demonstrations with aligned robot-view observations and controller-compatible whole-body state-action labels. Egocentric human demonstrations offer scalable supervision but have misaligned views and sparse motion cues. Existing approaches either pretrain policies that still require robot data for adaptation or generate controller-specific commands that limit reuse. Conversion also requires robot-view observations aligned with the generated whole-body motion. We present KODA (Kinematics-Observation Data Alignment), which converts egocentric RGB demonstrations into whole-body VLA training data using a reusable canonical trajectory to guide robot-view synthesis and generate controller-specific whole-body state-action supervision. KODA first generates a simulator-checked whole-body trajectory using a sparse tracker with sampling-based command optimization. This generated trajectory directly determines the onboard camera poses used to synthesize corresponding robot-view observations. The motion, observations, and task instruction form a canonical record. For each deployment controller, KODA optimizes commands to track the stored motion and records the corresponding action labels and proprioceptive states. When switching controllers, KODA retains this canonical record and regenerates whole-body state-action supervision for co-training with matching robot demonstrations. We evaluate KODA on four Unitree G1 loco-manipulation tasks using two whole-body controllers, SONIC and HEFT. With robot data held fixed, macro-average success on conditions covered by human demonstrations but absent from robot data improves by 45.0 and 46.25 percentage points, respectively. Under both controllers, this metric shows an upward trend across the evaluated human-data budgets, suggesting potential for further scaling.

papers.title_en: Inertially Significant Humanoid Teleoperation via Whole Body Model Predictive Control and Online Parameter Estimation
papers.authors: James Foster, Beomyeong Park, Luigi Penco, Robert Griffin
papers.evidence: 结合在线惯性参数估计的人形全身模型预测控制
papers.tldr: 人形机器人使用重工具或携带大载荷时，惯量变化会显著影响动力学与平衡，单靠反馈控制难以补偿。本文将全身模型预测控制（WB-MPC）与扩展卡尔曼滤波（EKF）结合，在线估计物理一致且时变的惯性参数，并用于完整刚体动力学以改善前馈力矩。系统还提供VR遥操作接口，操作者只需给出任务参考，平衡由WB-MPC负责。仿真与硬件实验验证了该框架的有效性。
papers.abstract_en: The effective deployment of humanoid robots in practical tasks of interest will require a capability of sensing and adapting to variations in inertial parameters, as occurs during heavy tool use or when carrying significant payload. Such payloads constitute a significant proportion of the combined payload-robot system, the effects of which cannot be ignored by delegating to feedback control. This paper showcases a general solution to this problem by integrating a whole body model predictive controller (WB-MPC) with an extended Kalman filter (EKF) for online estimation of fully physically consistent time-varying inertial parameters. These estimates are fed through to the WB-MPC's full rigid body dynamics model, resulting in more accurate feedforward torques for task demands under external load. Additionally, a virtual reality (VR) interface is provided that enables an operator to provide task-specific references without regard to payload while delegating dynamic balance to the WB-MPC. The framework is validated with simulation and hardware experiments on a humanoid system.

papers.title_en: Multimodal Interaction Estimation for Contact-Aware Adaptive Impedance Control
papers.authors: Mateusz Jaszczuk, Paris Perdikaris, Nadia Figueroa
papers.evidence: 面向安全人机接触的多模态交互估计与自适应阻抗控制
papers.tldr: 机器人需在有人环境中安全精准作业，但仅靠力信号难区分未知负载与人类推挤，视觉又易受遮挡。本文用Transformer融合力历史与3D点云，做与任务无关的交互类型估计，并以模态丢弃和仿真到硬件微调提升鲁棒性。分类准确率达91.89%，单模态完全遮挡时仍超90%，并驱动负载选择性补偿、变阻抗自适应/反应切换及交互力估计。在单臂、模仿学习策略、意图切换和双臂零样本抬箱中验证，展现对闭链与未见场景的泛化。
papers.abstract_en: With advancements in learning-based policies, robots are increasingly being deployed in human-centric environments, such as manufacturing floors and homes, where safe and precise operation requires compensating for unknown loads while remaining compliant during human interactions. Reliably distinguishing between these interaction types is challenging with a single sensing modality, as force signals cannot separate payloads from human pushes, and vision is susceptible to occlusions. We propose a task-agnostic interaction estimation and adaptive control framework that addresses this challenge by fusing force history and 3D point cloud through a transformer-based classifier. Trained with modality dropout for occlusion resilience and fine-tuned from simulation to hardware, the classifier achieves 91.89% accuracy and maintains above 90% under complete occlusion of one modality. The classifier drives a system identification framework that selectively compensates for unknown payloads and a variable-impedance controller that switches between adaptive and reactive modes, while simultaneously estimating interaction forces for downstream tasks, such as human intent estimation. We validate the framework under external perturbations and unknown loads across single-arm manipulation, deployment with an imitation-learning-based policy, intent-driven target switching, and zero-shot bimanual deployment on two Franka arms lifting a box of unknown mass, demonstrating generalization to closed kinematic chains and unseen setups, enabling safe and precise deployment.

papers.title_en: DiPLO: Self-distilled Diffusion Planning for Loco-manipulation
papers.authors: Shafeef Omar, Sebastian Sanokowski, Elham Daneshmand, Dian Yu, Daniel Cremers, Cordelia Schmid, Majid Khadiv
papers.evidence: 人到人形动作重定向加强化学习全身跟踪策略，用于移动操作
papers.tldr: DPO去除强任务条件依赖，并用DA:PPO对齐冻结跟踪器。拾取-搬运-放置任务成功率从45%升至99%，还能泛化到未见目标，并在Unitree G1真机零微调重复执行。
papers.abstract_en: Humanoid loco-manipulation is particularly challenging because it requires coordinating locomotion, balance, and object interaction, making it difficult to learn from limited demonstrations or from scratch through Reinforcement Learning (RL). We introduce DiPLO (self-distilled Diffusion Planning for Loco-manipulation), a framework that combines a self-distilled diffusion planner with a low-level whole-body tracking policy. Our planner is pretrained via supervised learning on motions derived from human-to-humanoid retargeting, while the tracker is trained via RL to execute them. DiPLO centers around two complementary post-training stages. First, we introduce Self-Distillation Diffusion Policy Optimisation (SD:DPO) to remove the planner's dependence on strong task conditioning, which we identify as a crucial ingredient for effective pretraining, as downstream fine-tuning does not recover comparable performance when it is omitted.. We then fine-tune this distilled model with Diffusion-Augmented Proximal Policy Optimization (DA:PPO), a maximum-entropy RL method for diffusion models, to improve task success and align generated plans with the frozen tracker's execution capabilities. Together, these stages enable motion generation through state-history and goal conditioning alone, enabling 99% task success in pick-carry-place tasks, compared to just 45% for the pretrained model. The resulting planner also generates motions for unseen object goals, with further evaluations on kicking and pushing/pulling tasks. Finally, we deploy our pipeline on the hardware, using our DA:PPO planner-tracker on a Unitree G1, achieving repeated successful executions without any real-world fine-tuning.

papers.title_en: SWAP: Test-Time Steerable Humanoid Whole-Body Collision Avoidance
papers.authors: Zeji Yi, Guanqi He, Xiaofeng Guo, Guannan Qu, Pieter Abbeel, Yan Duan, Karen Liu, Guanya Shi
papers.evidence: 基于感知的人形全身避障与平衡控制
papers.tldr: 人形机器人在狭窄杂乱环境中需全身协调避障并保持平衡，现有方法难以兼顾动态稳定与高维感知下的多模态安全行为。SWAP采用分层框架：高层扩散策略生成多模态避障运动提案，低层全身RL控制器跟踪并维持平衡，并通过事后标注构造无碰撞监督。仿真与Unitree G1实验显示其能可靠避开静态和动态障碍，测试时引导使速度、朝向或姿态等目标奖励平均提升34%且保持高避障率。该工作提供了可测试时定制的人形全身避障方案。
papers.abstract_en: Humanoid robots operating in human-centric environments must coordinate the entire body to traverse tight, cluttered spaces while maintaining balance. Existing methods often struggle to jointly consider dynamic stability and collision avoidance from high-dimensional perceptual inputs. Moreover, for humanoids, safe behavior is inherently multimodal: the same obstacle may admit multiple valid traversals, which is difficult to represent with a single deterministic policy. To address these challenges, we propose SWAP (Steerable Whole-body Avoidance Policy), a hierarchical framework that separates collision-aware decision making from stabilization. A high-level, perception-conditioned diffusion policy generates multimodal, collision-aware motion proposals, while a low-level whole-body RL controller tracks these proposals and maintains dynamic balance. To efficiently train the high-level policy, we obtain scalable supervision via hindsight labeling: we roll out the low-level policy under randomized commands, place obstacles only in the space that each executed motion did not sweep, so the motion is collision-free by construction, and re-render the perception the robot would have seen. At deployment, Monte Carlo sampling with simple cost signals steers the diffusion model toward safe, task-aligned behaviors without heavy reward tuning.   Experiments in simulation and on a real Unitree G1 humanoid show reliable avoidance with static and dynamic obstacles. Test-time steering further enables customization, improving targeted rewards (e.g., speed, orientation, or posture) by 34% on average while maintaining a high collision avoidance rate. Together, these results support a practical solution to humanoid whole-body collision avoidance with test-time steerability. Project website: https://iscoyizj.github.io/SWAP-steerable-humanoid-oa-website/

papers.title_en: LiDAR-based Humanoid Navigation in Dynamic, Non-Convex Environments via Spatio-Temporal Safe Corridors
papers.evidence: 激光雷达感知与落脚规划及全身控制耦合的人形导航
papers.tldr: 动态非凸环境中的类人机器人导航需紧耦合感知、步态规划与全身控制，现有方法常用简化凸障碍边界且忽略实时动态占据预测。本文提出基于LiDAR粒子表示直接构建时空安全走廊的实时框架，并将其与LIP规划及WBC结合。Digit仿真在24×24 m²场地绕行和进入移动非凸障碍的成功率达96%，消融显示迭代多面体生成在窄走廊显著优于单次迭代。该工作提升了复杂动态场景下类人导航的实时性与鲁棒性。
papers.abstract_en: Navigating humanoid robots through dynamic, non-convex environments requires tightly coupling onboard perception with footstep planning and dynamic locomotion control. Existing methods frequently discard complex free space through simplified convex obstacle bounds and fail to account for real-time dynamic occupancy predictions. This paper presents a real-time framework for humanoid navigation that directly constructs spatio-temporal safe corridors from LiDAR-based particle representations and couples them with Linear Inverted Pendulum (LIP)-based planning and Whole Body Control (WBC) to enable navigation around and within moving non-convex structures without restrictive geometric assumptions. Simulations on the Digit humanoid yield a 96% success rate in navigating around and inside moving non-convex obstacles in a 24 by 24 m^2 arena. Ablation studies confirm that the proposed iterative polytope generation significantly outperforms single-iteration baselines in narrow corridors, while evaluations demonstrate robustness to clutter, sensor noise, control delays, and force perturbations.

papers.title_en: Locomotion with Online Awareness of Dynamics for Precision Footholds
papers.authors: Kunzhao Ren, Zhishuo Zhu, Xiaobin Xiong
papers.evidence: 基于深度感知的足式运动策略与真机迁移
papers.tldr: 未知负载会改变机器人动力学，在窄梁等小落脚余量场景中难以精确落脚。LOAD 将显式惯性估计与隐式动力学特征结合：循环模块从本体感知推断躯干惯性变化与任务历史，并将高度图教师蒸馏到深度学生策略。仿真与硬件实验表明，隐式特征加速训练，显式惯性估计进一步提升成功率；二者结合接近使用真值惯性参数的 privileged 策略。硬件上实现 10 cm 梁单侧 6 kg、15 cm 梁单侧 9 kg 及均布 11 kg 负载穿越。
papers.abstract_en: Unknown payloads alter robot dynamics and make precise contact execution difficult when foothold margins are small. We present LOAD, a perceptive locomotion framework that combines explicit inertial estimates with implicit dynamics features for narrow-beam traversal. Separate recurrent modules infer torso inertial changes and task-relevant history from proprioception, while a height-map teacher is distilled into a depth-based student. We extensively evaluate LOAD and its variants in simulation and on hardware across beam widths and payload configurations. The results show that implicit dynamics features accelerate training, while explicit inertial estimation further improves traversal success; combining both enables LOAD to approach the performance of a privileged policy supplied with ground-truth inertial parameters. Hardware experiments demonstrate traversal with unilateral payloads of 6 kg on a 10 cm beam and 9 kg on a 15 cm beam, and an evenly distributed 11 kg payload on a 15 cm beam. These results support combining physical estimates and history features for precision locomotion under unknown loads.

papers.title_en: EgoExplorer: A Vision-Motion-Touch Observatory for Human Loco-Manipulation In Situ
papers.authors: Yunsong Zhou, Xuekun Jiang, Haiqi Shen, Hangxu Liu, Chaojian Shi, Yujie Liu, Jingyuan Li, Haoran Yang, Jiafei Cao, Dongzhan Zhou, Dong Wang, Yao Mu, Chunhua Shen, Weinan Zhang
papers.evidence: 面向人体移动操作学习的自我中心视觉-运动-触觉数据集
papers.tldr: 针对人形机器人从人类演示学习移动操作时缺乏移动、姿态与物体交互同步观测的问题，EgoExplorer构建了100小时可穿戴视觉-运动-触觉数据集，对齐自我中心视频、全身运动、手指关节与触觉并附步骤描述。其Calibrate-Complete-Constrain流程用可复用标定解耦佩戴偏移，结合时序先验补全未观测关节，并以分层约束保证测量一致、时序连续与几何一致。相比最强基线，身体点误差降低71.9%，手部稳定性与接触估计也有提升。
papers.abstract_en: Learning humanoid loco-manipulation from human demonstrations rests on observing how locomotion, posture, and object interaction evolve together as tasks unfold. Scaling collection across diverse environments, in turn, favors lightweight, portable capture systems. Yet, existing datasets provide only partial views of this coordination. Thus, we introduce EgoExplorer, a 100-hour vision-motion-touch observatory of human loco-manipulation built with a wearable system. With an emphasis on professional activities, its continuous recordings align egocentric video with reconstructed whole-body motion, fine-grained finger articulation, and tactile observations, accompanied by step-level descriptions. To achieve this coverage with sparse body sensing, we develop the Calibrate-Complete-Constrain pipeline. Concretely, reusable calibration fixes participant geometry and sensor attachments before motion inference to disentangle mounting offsets from articulation. A temporal prior then completes unobserved joint motion, while layered constraints promote measurement agreement, temporal continuity, and geometric consistency, properties that motion plausibility alone does not guarantee. Against tracker-fitted references, the method reduces body-point error by 71.9% relative to the strongest baseline; matched evaluations also show gains in hand stability and contact estimation. Preliminary studies explore multimodal generation and conditioning alongside humanoid retargeting with whole-body control in simulation.

papers.title_en: $λ_0$: Scaling Open-World Egocentric Human Data for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
papers.evidence: 人到人形机器人的第一人称运动数据迁移用于移动操作学习
papers.tldr: 人形机器人全身移动操作受限于大规模真机示教成本，现有第一人称人类数据又缺少移动与姿态信息。作者构建500小时HumanVerse数据集，并提出对齐视角/外观、离线修正动作与控制器输入的人到人形流水线。该流水线实现到Unitree G1的零样本迁移，并用于训练人形基础模型λ0。λ0在SIMPLE达90.0%，真实世界移动操作任务平均62.5%，且全身人类数据增加持续提升下游进展。
papers.abstract_en: Humanoid loco-manipulation requires coordinated whole-body interaction with the physical world, yet collecting robot demonstrations at scale remains costly. Human demonstrations offer a scalable alternative, but existing egocentric human supervision often omits locomotion and posture, while embodiment differences and controller dynamics hinder accurate end-effector execution. We introduce HumanVerse, a 500-hour dataset of open-world human loco-manipulation pairing egocentric video with synchronized body and hand motion. Our human-to-humanoid pipeline aligns camera viewpoints and arm appearance, and refines motion references and controller inputs offline to reduce end-effector errors while preserving whole-body coordination. We validate the pipeline through zero-shot transfer to Unitree G1 on representative whole-body manipulation and long-range loco-manipulation tasks, without target-task robot demonstrations. Building on this pipeline, we develop $λ_0$, a humanoid foundation model for whole-body loco-manipulation, with robot-aligned human demonstrations providing supervision for mid-training. Increasing whole-body human data consistently improves downstream task progress. $λ_0$ achieves 90.0% success on SIMPLE and 62.5% across real-world loco-manipulation tasks. We expect this study to guide scalable whole-body human data collection toward humanoid foundation models for richer interaction with the physical world. Homepage: https://lambdahumanoid.github.io/

papers.title_en: A Mode-Unified, Continuous, and Biomimetic Control Strategy of a Robotic Lower Limb Prosthesis
papers.authors: Hanjun Kim, Sixu Zhou, John Shim, Xinyuan Guo, Kinsey R. Herrin, Aaron J. Young
papers.evidence: 依赖步态相位与地形坡度的连续阻抗控制
papers.tldr: 现有仿生下假肢控制多按平地、坡道和楼梯分别调参，难以连续适应地形。本文用RBF插值统一上下坡多项式模型，将膝关节与踝关节生物力学表示为坡度与步态相位的连续函数，并转化为坡度相关阻抗参数，嵌入单一有限状态机控制器。10名单侧股骨截肢者实验显示，可跨越平地至35°坡道/楼梯，膝部指标r²=0.82–0.99、踝运动学r²=0.78–0.96。结果表明统一参数化无需分模式调参即可保留健康人关键生物力学特征。
papers.abstract_en: Existing biomimetic lower-limb prosthesis controllers are commonly designed for discrete locomotion modes, requiring separate parameterizations for level walking, ramps, and stairs. We present a mode-unified prosthesis control framework that represents knee and ankle biomechanics continuously as functions of terrain slope and gait phase across those locomotion conditions. Locally optimized ascent and descent polynomial models were unified using radial basis function (RBF) interpolation, preserving the accuracy of the partitioned models while outperforming a global polynomial representation. The resulting biomechanics were transformed into continuous and slope-dependent impedance parameters and implemented within a single finite-state-machine (FSM) controller using bilateral sensing for gait-state estimation. Experiments with 10 individuals with transfemoral amputation demonstrated terrain-adaptive locomotion from level walking through ramps and stairs up to 35 degrees, including 13 degree ramp and 15 degree stair conditions absent from the underlying able-bodied (AB) dataset. Experimental results reproduced the principal slope-dependent biomechanical trends predicted by the unified model, with high agreement for knee-related measures (r-square = 0.82 - 0.99) and ankle kinematics (r-square= 0.78 - 0.96). These findings demonstrated that unified biomechanical parameterization enables a prosthesis control architecture across diverse terrain conditions while preserving key features of AB biomechanics without requiring independently tuned impedance parameter sets for each locomotion mode.

papers.title_en: Safe Reinforcement Learning with Receding-Horizon Safety Critic and Differentiable Action Shields
papers.authors: Siwei Ju, Jan Peters, Oleg Arenz
papers.evidence: 预测运动失效的滚动时域安全评论家
papers.tldr: 机器人强化学习的安全故障往往并非瞬时发生，而是在扰动和域偏移下随多步状态漂移逐步累积。论文学习滚动时域安全评论家，预测未来时域内是否保持非终止，并用集成与CVaR保守聚合处理不确定性。基于该评论家推导可微分CBF式安全过滤器，以最小动作修正提升预测安全性，并在PPO中加入预见损失缓解策略-过滤器不匹配。四足仿真表明方法在动作噪声、外部扰动和地形变化下减少灾难性失败并保持有竞争力回报。
papers.abstract_en: Despite the Markov assumption, safety failures in robot reinforcement learning rarely occur instantaneously; they typically emerge over several steps as the policy enters unfamiliar states under disturbances and domain shift. We address this limitation by learning a receding-horizon safety critic that predicts whether a state will remain non-terminating over the next receding horizon, enabling anticipatory detection of impending locomotion failures. The critic is trained from rollout-derived horizon labels with a composite objective that combines horizon classification, control-barrier-function-inspired temporal consistency, and smoothness regularization, and we aggregate an ensemble of critics with a conservative Conditional Value at Risk estimate to account for uncertainty. Building on the learned critic, we derive a closed-form, differentiable CBF-style safety filter that minimally modifies the policy action to improve predicted safety, and integrate it into PPO with an anticipation loss to reduce policy-filter mismatch during training. In simulated quadruped locomotion, our method improves robustness under action noise, external perturbations, and terrain shifts, reducing catastrophic failures while maintaining competitive returns.

papers.title_en: Attribution-Gated Joint Estimation of Intention and Capability for Assist-as-Needed Upper-Limb Robots
papers.authors: Pengcheng Li, Shuxiang Guo, Hanze Wang, Jun Leng, Bin Wang, Mingchao Ding
papers.evidence: 移动时域估计与模型预测控制在线估计意图与力矩能力以自适应助力
papers.tldr: 按需辅助上肢机器人必须区分运动意图变化与有效自主力矩能力变化，但两者会造成相似的运动和交互响应。作者构建双测度MHE-MPC框架，并引入归因门，把轨迹与能力更新通道的歧义转化为连续信用分配问题。九名健康受试者九种条件下，门控方法RMSE最低为0.017 rad，明显优于未门控双估计和固定参考误差AAN。疲劳后能力估计下降且辅助增加，说明该方法能提高按需辅助的归因准确性与功能可行性。
papers.abstract_en: Assist-as-needed (AAN) control must distinguish between changes in intended motion and changes in effective voluntary torque capability, even though both can produce similar kinematic and interaction responses. A dual-measurand multimodal MHE-MPC architecture is developed as the base framework, in which the intended trajectory and the task-dependent effective voluntary torque capability are estimated online as distinct quantities, and both estimates are used to adapt robotic assistance. Building on this architecture, the ambiguity between the two update channels is formulated as a continuous credit-assignment problem and resolved by an attribution gate. A trajectory-change indicator is obtained from persistent corrective interaction, whereas a capability-change indicator is derived from the residual between normalized muscle activation and dynamics-reconstructed voluntary torque. Nine healthy participants completed factorial target-height-load trials and a pre-post fatigue cup-transport task. Without target-height input, the gated method generated correctly ordered Low-Middle-High references under every load: target changes were preferentially assigned to trajectory adaptation, whereas added load shifted adaptation toward the capability channel. It achieved the lowest RMSE in all nine conditions (0.017 rad versus 0.041 rad for ungated dual estimation and 0.127 rad for fixed-reference error-based AAN). Post-fatigue capability estimates decreased and assistance increased at all heights, supporting functional feasibility.
